stories.title: Wrexham to Bidston trains cancelled for rest of day as Transport for Wales runs short of trains
stories.summary: Trains between Wrexham and Bidston are being cancelled in both directions for the rest of Thursday because Transport for Wales does not have enough trains available. stories.title: Buckley resident says GoSafe will not explain why Linthorpe Road is refused speed enforcement
stories.summary: A resident living on a speeding driver ‘rat-run’ in Buckley says road safety partnership GoSafe has refused to explain why it won’t enforce speed monitoring. Richard Shone says drivers using the narrow Linthorpe Road in Buckley routinely exceed the 20mph limit – but his pleas for traffic calming measures and speed enforcement have been dismissed.

stories.title: Hawarden High School A-level students secure university places and apprenticeships
stories.summary: Students at Hawarden High School collected their A-level results on Thursday, with places confirmed at Imperial College London and degree apprenticeships with Airbus and Grant Thornton.
